Episode 213. Rift, A Sign of Great Change (3)
Luna, Zed, Vanessa, Tuben, Heijin.
The five knights who returned to the clan following Chiron's orders. Upon hearing Luna's voice welcoming him, Jin wondered for a moment if this was a dream.
Even as the Red Owl descended beside the five, he worried that they might disappear like a mirage.
It wasn't a dream.
Jin, who got off the Red Owl, nearly shed tears, but he couldn't show such a sight to his sister he hadn't seen for a long time.
Smack!
Without any precedence, Luna and Jin hugged each other. The rest of the group shielded the shockwave that was transmitted as the siblings felt the thrill of reunion after a long time.
"You've grown more reliable, little one."
"Haha! This guy was about to cry just now."
"Don't say that to our little one, Uncle Zed. You were the same when you met father."
"Uncle Zed, Knight Vanessa, Knight Tuben. And...!"
Heijin was a person whose name Jin did not know. As Jin hesitated while calling out the names of the returnees in his joy, Heijin smiled.
"Nice to meet you, Little Lord. I am Heijin Kreil. I've been ordered by the Lord to serve you from now on."
"Nice to meet you, Knight Heijin. But you just called me the Little Lord...?"
Jin becoming the Little Lord was a decision made by the previous Lords. There was no way that news could have reached the expedition in the Black Sea.
'Ah, did my father perhaps check the fact that I became the Little Lord through an oracle?'
Of course not.

"Runcandel Lord, Chiron Runcandel's command. I, Chiron Runcandel, appoint the 12th generation of the clan, Jin Runcandel, as the Little Lord, and declare him to be my legitimate and lawful successor."
As Luna said so and knelt on one knee, Zed and the former Black Knights followed suit and raised their swords in salute.

"First generation of the clan, Luna Runcandel, elder Zed Runcandel, former Black Knight Vanessa Olson, Heijin Kreil, Tuben. From now on, the five of us will be the most loyal swords to the Little Lord."
"We pledge!"
"We will serve with all our might."

Although he had already been functioning as the Little Lord, Jin felt a pang of guilt for some reason. Also, it was indescribably burdensome to receive the salute of those who were no different from the pillars of the clan.
But there was also a feeling of 'finally'.
'Finally... I'm officially recognized by my father.'
28 years before the return.
23 years after the return.
A total of 51 years had passed. The many things he had experienced, the miserable past life, and the dazzling present life days all flashed through his mind like a film.
All of these seemed to turn into a drop of tear ready to roll down his cheek. But Jin swallowed his tears once again and looked down at Luna and the knights.
Now is not the time to be sentimental. Not everything has ended yet, and it's not a time of peace and prosperity for the clan and the world.
Now is the time to do his duty as the Little Lord.

"I never thought I would see you all here. I want to share our backlog of stories and hold a grand welcoming ceremony, but unfortunately, Runcandel's territory is under attack. So let's delay our celebration a bit, and I'll give you an order."
"Please tell us anything."
"This purple rift is caused by the Demon King of the Demon World, Zito, infringing on our territory. Returnees, please immediately remove the rift and the enemies that have arisen from it."
"We understand your command."
Luna, Zed, and the former Black Knights stood up and raised their swords.
The return of the ones who could be called the 'Strongest of the Clan' was signaled by Luna's final move, known to all of our allies.
Runcandel's Third Ultimate Move
Meteor Shower
The dazzling sword that had once saved Jin in his junior years was sweeping away the purple aura of the purple rift on the Citadel.
"Huh, that doesn't seem like the Little Brother's Meteor Shower, right? Right, Sister Mary?"
"…It can't be. That's Sister Luna's Meteor Shower!"
Mary was the first to recognize Luna's Meteor Shower. As soon as the name 'Luna' came out of her mouth, the Tona brothers couldn't believe their ears.
[Luna? Did you say Luna? My eldest granddaughter who I've heard so much about only in stories?]
Ballas and the other knights were also looking at the Meteor Shower. Luna's Meteor Shower was impressively accurate, penetrating the wills of Zito mixed among the knights.
As Luna leaped into the center of the battlefield and began to swing the ax-sword Krantel in earnest, the knights screamed without knowing.
"Sister Luna!"
"It's really Luna! I can't believe it!"
"White Knight...!"
"The first generation, the White Knight has returned...!"
"All the knights of the clan, fight without fear. Elder Zed, the former Black Knights, and I will protect you!"
Luna's voice echoed across the battlefield. Jin could tell from the energy in her voice alone.
She was still a warrior who could be called the strongest knight of the clan.
Just as Jin had become stronger over time, Luna had also broken her limits several times while exploring the Dark Sea.

"Furthermore, the Clan Lord is still healthy and is currently exploring the Dark Sea. So don't worry that our return may have caused any changes to the Clan Lord. I'll say it once again. The Clan Lord has become even stronger. He has overcome demonization and reached the pinnacle of enlightenment!"
Cheers erupted from various parts of the battlefield.
The battlefield was now not just a chaotic fight against the unknown monsters of the Demon World, but it had turned into a festive atmosphere.

"You look a bit haggard since I last saw you, you brat. As my brother said, you've been busy and in danger. I'm sorry I couldn't fight with you when you finished your training and returned to the clan. We'll handle things here today, so feel free to enjoy the view."
"When I first saw the Little Lord in the Dark Sea thanks to Ozdok, I had a feeling that this day would come. It's an honor to serve you, Little Lord."
"The Clan Lord often thought of the Little Lord even when he was most severely eroded by the demonization. We will eradicate the enemies and visit you again soon."
Zed, Toben, and Heijin passed by Jin and said.
A beat late, Jin turned around to see them charging into the battlefield and felt an indescribable sense of pride.
It was the pride of Runcandel.
"Wow, those guys. It's great they're back, but I wasn't even in their thoughts... But aren't I the guardian dragon of the clan? Unbelievable."
"They didn't even say hello to me."
"Oh, you."
"You? You keep losing your mind, Murakan. Should I really torment you like Misha?"

"Those are the Ameris nobles! They don't know who this is. Please don't be so picky. It seems like they immediately reported their return to the kid and carried out the orders. In this situation, the kid should be the main character, right? Oh my, our little one is commendable."
"You're the one who first threw a tantrum because there was no greeting, Murakan."
"Heh, don't be so picky."
Although they sounded upset, in fact, Murakan and Ameris were just happy. The two knew better than anyone the pressure Jin had been under recently.
[Growl!]
The materialized wills of Zito were letting out groans and retreating. As soon as the returnees joined, Runcandel quickly gained momentum and was overwhelmingly pushing back the enemies.
Even if the actual Zito was here instead of his will, it would still feel incredibly reassuring. In fact, no matter what enemy Jin would face in the future, it would not be as daunting as before.

The wills of Zito, dismantled by the swords of the returnees, were being restored into the fissure without any strength. Although new wills were emerging from the crack, they had no effect on the battle situation.

"If the returnees weren't here, you probably would have had to deal with most of those wills alone, Jin. The will of Zito, like the fissure, can only be defeated with a special power. The swords of those who have returned, including your sister, are all imbued with such power."
The swords of the returnees, who had won against the most horrific monsters and kings of the Black Sea many times, were all in the realm of authority.

It was specialized for dealing with non-human, transcendent beings or monsters with special abilities. Thus, even non-pure-blooded Rune Kendels, like the Black Knights of previous generations, were effectively wielding a type of demon sword. The only difference was that it wasn't magic that gave their swords power, but their will.
The materialized wills of Zito had all disappeared before ten minutes had passed.

However, the situation was not completely resolved. The crack, from which all wills had been restored, was radiating a much stronger shockwave than before. It seemed as if a powerful demon would burst through the crack at any moment.
Only then did Jin draw his sword for the first time.

The fissure in Shiathelo had to be cut and extinguished, even if it meant getting injured. And now, even if he fell injured and needed treatment, the power gap during that time wouldn't be as severe as before.
"Little brother, won't you get hurt if you cut that?"
Luna approached as Jin was preparing his spirit sword.

"Yes, sister, you understand quickly. However, if left alone, that crack will summon an entire outpost or city from the demon world into Shiathelo. That's why I've mostly left the cracks alone until now. This was to prepare for when I need to eliminate the cracks in crucial areas like here in Shiathelo."
Luna nodded.
"Good judgment. But unlike you, I am quite sturdy?"
Luna exaggeratedly flexed her body and lifted Krantel.
"Yes?"

"I mean, even if I eliminate that crack, I won't take much of a hit. Ah, I guess it will deduct some of the number of times father mentioned... but still, to protect Shiathelo, I should accept that much."
Suddenly, Luna was shining with a red light. Her eyes, as well as her ax sword Krantel, were dyed with a deep red aura.
"So I'll take care of this. Wow, it brings back memories. I also used this sword when I rescued you."
Deep sword
Bloody moon
As Luna whispered an incantation onto Krantel, a red brilliance spread across the sky and the earth.
Most of the knights couldn't even perceive the moment Krantel was swung. Shortly after, a red flash cut through the middle of the crack.
That was the moment the enormous crack disappeared without a trace.
